build_clippedlinear_transform: build a python module that uses ClippedLinear to scale and clip errors from bad to 0 and good to 1
build_negexp_transform: build a python module that uses NegExp to scale errors exponentially with sharp gradient near the target
build_sigmoid_transform: build a python module that uses Sigmoid to scale errors between 0.05 and 0.95 with configurable good and bad values
build_softplus_transform: build a python module that uses SoftPlus to scale errors from bad to 0.1 and good to 1 using a logistic curve
build_equal_transform: build a python module that uses Equal to return 1 for zero errors and a configurable value otherwise
